referee_caveats_inferred: Fitted Tex (90 K for B) is lower than the about 300 K from prior CH3OH and CH3OD work; the authors attribute part of this to high-Tex line predictions that are not seen, so the result depends on high-excitation lines.
Statistical MCMC errors (about 1-2%) are far smaller than the adopted 10%/20% pessimistic errors; the quoted D/H uncertainty is set by the assumed errors, not by the fit.
CH3OH column densities from other papers drive the D/H values and are based on different methods for A and B.
Comparisons across sources rely on heterogeneous literature analyses (different isotopic ratios, optical-depth treatments and beams).
